# stewiefeh studios

Custom websites built from scratch for local businesses in South Jersey, New Jersey. Every site is designed and coded by hand for one business at a time. Before any payment, the client receives a working sample of their own site with their branding on it; if they like it, it gets built out, and if not, they owe nothing.

## Pricing

- Landing page: $750 one-time, one conversion-focused page built from scratch
- Full custom site: $1,650 one-time, three pages or more, each designed from scratch
- Hosting and care: $50/month, hosting, backups, monitoring, and small content updates
